tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: warm, paper-like, easy on the eyes for long reading.

tokens.name: paper-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces: sidebars, table header rows, the course navigation.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and encyclopedia fact panels on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-alt and card (13:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, last-changed dates (5.3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls (3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: leaf-700
tokens.usage: Brand green: links, primary buttons, active navigation, references to encyclopedia entries.

tokens.name: leaf-500
tokens.usage: Brand green for large shapes and illustrations; not for small text.

tokens.name: leaf-100
tokens.usage: Green tint: tip admonitions, selected states, chips for positive values.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text on leaf-700 (primary button label).

tokens.name: sun-800
tokens.usage: Ochre text and icons for notes and highlights.

tokens.name: sun-100
tokens.usage: Ochre tint: note admonitions, season highlights.

tokens.name: blossom-700
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: harmful practices, toxicity, pest damage.

tokens.name: blossom-100
tokens.usage: Warning tint: warning admonitions, susceptible values.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Info text and links to external videos.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Info tint: info admonitions, video cards.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring around interactive elements (3:1+ on every surface).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title: course topic, encyclopedia entry.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Az alany határozza meg, mekkorára nő a fa, és milyen hamar fordul termőre.
styles.usage: Course topic text. Generous size and line height for long reading; keep lines at 60–75 characters.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, metadata, last-changed dates. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in fact panels, small headings above lists. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside small components.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between form controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, admonitions.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Images, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: season and status chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on paper. Subtle: the design relies on hairlines and tints, not depth.
